releases.notes:
# Statistiques - v0.2.0-alpha

> Bow, crossbow and trident new statistics are out ! Track shot arrows and thrown tridents.

## ⚡ Features

- Record statistics on your items:
    - Killed entities (hostile, neutral and passives) with a bow, crossbow, mace, sword or trident.
    - Shot, missed and hit arrows with a bow or a crossbow.
    - Thrown, missed and hit tridents with a trident.
- Statistics are now sort alphabetically in the tooltip.

___

## 🛠 Upcoming

- New statistics:
    - Hits :
        - Total given hits;
        - Successful hits;
        - Missed hits.
    - Broken blocks :
        - Specific block-related statistics for the different tools.

___

## 🔮 Additional information

- This is the second alpha release of my second *Minecraft* mod. This mod means a lot to me, as it is developed only to fulfill my nerd-needs of statistics when I play the game ; In addition to be a reason for me to train using *Java*. Any feedback are highly welcomed, so don't hesitate to send an e-mail at `noahboos-dev@proton.me`.
